It also uses her calf tightness as evidence for that answer. The progression is gentle: 30 minutes Monday and Wednesday, and 33 minutes Saturday with one extra jog round. It also adds light strength work. That fits a 41-year-old beginner, and every day can be run as written.

Third, nothing links next week's 90-second jogs to what she actually did this week, so it's hard to confirm the plan builds on it. Safe and useful, but the broken table and the made-up detail hold it to a middling score.
